text:
Sasha: Evening handoff — quick list before I sign off. Load is steady but small tail latency bump on eu-west2 2x GPUs since ~1600 UTC. No user-facing errors.

Sasha: What changed: rolled r-infer/2.1.4 -> 2.1.5 on staging earlier; promoted a small routing tweak for low-priority traffic. Didn’t touch dedicated pools.

Jamal: Noted. I saw a couple of 95p p99 spikes around 16:10, maybe batching degens. Will keep an eye.

Alex: FYI I merged a batching tweak (PR #512). It’s on canary in eu-west2. If you see memory pressure, revert with: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/rw-infer-canary -n inference`.

Sasha: Action items for tonight: 
- Jamal: monitor p95/p99 and kv-cache hit rate for eu-west2 (alert threshold 1.6x baseline).
- Priya: follow up with infra about the NIC firmware patch scheduled for 03:00 UTC tomorrow — if they proceed, expect short packet drops during rolling reboots.
- Alex: keep an eye on canary PR metrics and be ready to revert.

Priya: Re: NIC patch — infra asked for a 30m maintenance window, they said they'd do staggered reboots across racks. I asked them to confirm exact host list. Will post update here when I get it.

Jamal: Quick check: any user-facing retries configured for model-fallback? If routing falls back from gpt-lite -> gpt-base we should expect latency jump but graceful degradation.

Sasha: Yes, fallback policy is enabled for the prod route: 200ms tail tolerant fallback to gpt-base. Logs show only ~3 fallbacks in last 24h.

Alex: Also pinging @oncall-bot to add eu-west2 latency watch to the channel for the next 6 hours.

oncall-bot: ✅ Monitoring rule added: inference.eu-west2.latency.p99 > 800ms for 5m -> post alert in #eng-oncall. Thresholds: p95 400ms, p99 800ms.

Sasha: Known risks: possible transient higher latency during infra patch, and the canary batching tweak may increase short-term p99 while optimizing throughput. No immediate rollback planned unless p99 > 1s or error rate > 0.5%.

Priya: If infra confirms host list, I’ll schedule a short pre-patch sanity run (healthcheck + smoke) and tag you all.

Jamal: I'll run a synthetic prompt set every 10m for the next 3 hours and post results. If anyone sees a spike, call pager.

Alex: Also there are 2 open PR reviews blocking a release: #517 and #520. I can review #517 tonight, leaving #520 for morning.

Sasha: Thanks. Last note: if you need to drain a node use this safe drain: 
```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

Sasha: I'm out at 18:30 UTC. Jamal you’re primary overnight, Priya backup. Ping me if anything odd. :wave:

Jamal: Got it. Monitoring in place, will escalate if anything crosses thresholds. :eyes:

Priya: I'll update once infra confirms the reboot plan. Good night.
